latest_release.body:
## Changelog
* 614d97526481d6ea048eb977e91ea7c9d64140cb feat: add configurable HSTS
* 5ee1ba4a933346b4bbbe0719108472af6fb9ffee fix: map Windows lock roots back to request paths
* d08e2277baf9d4e287d7aa8078ee4c094dca5326 docs: update badges
* 778116bfee49b5f38fc714112ede4743296aaa3b refactor: drop unreachable directory mount types
* 34923d5057c7618ab06082015db386da6d5f0fbb docs: note that CORS credentials need specific origins
* 91a45ed4ede16bb8e1e6216f8a16a7f95c086ab6 fix: reject malformed bcrypt hashes at startup
* d6ad0d82a0c5a47639fc0f5b21bb1ca8fc4e7b21 fix: report a refreshed lock's root as a request path
* 2ca04b92c6204c0ecc2c9b4223279e81587bdf41 fix: refuse to unlock or refresh a lock outside the request path
* 47d8f24a13cc36eadf0cbe2eeab989f11c6436b1 feat: send Strict-Transport-Security over TLS
* 0b6d4a6dc73dde47cc5bdf610af87959fabb6550 fix: name the user whose username environment variable is empty
* bf6d193d35fa16f79f725c129f431d244e45ec76 refactor: strip the url prefix in one place
* 2ae3a95f8010aac1197978f8b67f35cc5c898659 refactor: make the directory absolute once
* 5b3fc34aba42f0914b0bf64c9199c6c9bdc296e2 refactor: remove unreachable byte range checks
* 294a9acc6f6f1e1ac9632780ca248d1aa7091eb7 chore: drop unused fallback root certificates
* 22c0ab4f98b38fdc3f787ed1673595c263ca55d7 fix: allow the Timeout and Translate headers in default CORS config
* c02062b2a627d80a976442bf81e8f47434de631c fix: refuse every failed login as slowly as a bcrypt check
* d50985a90c1125cf40cbb5efc0df6565b673eeba perf: skip the subtree walk when no rules apply
* f2efa329d612fdfc06c5a77a556549a8da93c579 perf: remember the last accepted password to skip repeated bcrypt checks
* 204531b26400a268eef7d28280ab4dc69a8f536b fix: exit with an error when the server fails to start
* 4c7938d587a0aafb4f06c9abfed27aa061df2b16 fix: add a temporary directory to the Docker image for partial updates
* 005d3b2a8624686165e2c7df5e41b4534c2ab43a fix: clean rule paths the way request paths are cleaned
* 564fa48a0ee0eb180189d2c4813f18cf59b0c390 fix: sandbox served files so uploaded pages cannot act as the viewer
* f198fdf89313505e660364aebf758101d22d7a3d fix: authorize the paths a copy or move creates under the destination
* 0ca5bbb260dc610aafacda8971249eecb477aaa7 perf: reuse directory metadata within PROPFIND requests (#368)
* 563efdd462d76e34595e91abb0fee070e504777b fix: skip destination lock condition check for MOVE operations (#357)
